book.name: 1 TIMOTIUS
book.title: Nyovara Wao Manasyin Paulus Po Ratoe Timotius Ai 1 TIMOTIUS

content: Kuruno angkari wo anugano Amisye mansaponae

Anawayo Vambunine mo raura kakavimbe mare arono munije ama akari mararai, indati vatan inta nawirati wo ananyao tugae rapaya ti ntami, yara wo anawayo kakaije raraniv ti utavondi awa ananyao angkarije bo rai.
Ananyao angkari umaso mamo kurune inta nanawirati wo raugaje anugano Amisye mansai. Kurune wato awa angkarije ntapekan. Mansanuga ngkaumur ti usamane awa ayao kakai raije ramu.

Awa ananyao angkari maisyare so: ware vemo vatane ubaunam inya, muno ware anaisye inta mamo raisyisyi. Weramu syo raura wasai syare anaisyo namije mamo Amisye pi po ranari ti Po raugaje indamu wandaisy. Weti vatano wamanave muno wananta ayao tugae rai, wamo kove raura seo Amisye aijo wama anaisye rai umba wandaisy.
Tugae, anakotaro Amisye po ranari omamo ngko tenambe. Anaisye inta raisyisyi jewen. Maisyare omai ti, wamo kove raura seo Amisy ai, weamo anaisye kotaro rui vayave wamo rai kaija.
Anaisye mamo ngko tenambe weye wamo kove raura seo Amisye aijo rai muno Apa ayao mo inta raura raisyisyije jewen.
Vatano panapatambe Yesus Kristus ai ti ngko dave

Timotius, ranivara nyo ayao umaso ranyao tenambe irati arakovo wanave Yesus Kristus aije mansai, wea umba nyanapatambe Yesus Kristus ai mamaisy ije. Nanuga ntubai mbambunin weye wino tawan no wama anave ama ayaowe rai muno ananyao ngkove rai, wemirati wintavondi raija nugoenta to.
Vemo nyo ayao umano mbe tugaive jewene ratantona nora, weye mo kove inta raunande ramu. Yara syare nyo taune nanuga ravera mbambunin indamu wintavondi Amisye apa bekere rai kobe.

Wamare wamo wansanasine raeranande indamu mbambunin, wemamo mo kovo mamaune raugavo wansai. Yara wamare wamo wansanuga ravera mbambunin indamu wantavondi Amisye apa bekere rai tenambe, wemamo mo kovo manakoe raugavo wansai, weye Amisye po kove raugaje wansai no mine vone so muno Po kove ratayao tavon ti mo wansanyut no munijo ntiti.
Ayao umaso tugae, syare wamanave rai.
Maisyare omai ti, wamo anakero Amisye raijar panyoambe weye wansanaveano Amisyo noa pitawabe obo amen, Opi po vatan tenambe mapaya ayao kakaije rai, nde terave vatano wamanave Ai wansai.
Paulus po ananyao inta raugaje Timotius ai
Timotius, syare ananyao umaso mamo nyo raugaje tenambe indamu vatane utavondi rai.

Ranivara vatane inta wo naura tatugadi weye winyamo vatano ngkamurama nene, vemo winsamane nora! Yara wimbe unanuive irati vatano wanave Yesus aije mansai. Syare nya ana ndaura, nya ana ndave, nya muinye, nya anave, muno nanuga ndandinit, mbe unanuive mai indamu wo narijat tenambe.
Syare nyo anakere so raijar tutir ava risyirati Paulus syakaore: wimbacave Ayao Amisye rai no anugano Amisye mansamun, nyo ama ine raura kakavimbe mai, muno nyo mansanyao.

Mbemo nanimari kovo vambunino namirati Anawayo Vambunine mo raugaje naije rai nora! Kovo vambunine wato nande nai arono nandijawe anawae inta wo Amisye apa urairi dapatimu nai raura nai muno akarijo wo anugano Amisye maugave wo maneme raijaseo ntamijo nai. Maisyare omai ti, syare nyo kovo vambunine wato veano anakero Amisye raijar.
Syare nyo Amisye apa anakere so raijaro panyoambe indamu vatan tenambe wo raen wo raura ware nya ana ndave ti ngko dave miridi nseowa.

Syare nyo nya ana ndave muno nya ananyaowe raeranande kobe indamu mamaisyo Amisye apa bekere obo rai. Natawandi tutir, weye indati Amisye po napaya irati ayao kakaije rai muno Po vatano wo nya ananyao raranive mapaya ayao kakaije rai tavon.
